title: Accelerating SO(2)-Equivariant Materials Models through Low-Precision Emulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35164v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rotationally equivariant architectures improve the physical fidelity of machine-learned (ML) universal materials models based on graph neural networks (GNNs). However, their scalability is limited by the use of non-trivial, high-precision tensor operations during both training and inference. Adopting the reduced-precision formats of matrix multiplication units (MMUs), e.g., FP8 instead of FP32, provides massive increases in throughput, up to 30x (60x) on NVIDIA Hopper (Blackwell) GPUs, but may lead to drastic loss of accuracy. Here, we introduce tailored 'emulated' low-precision operations under the integer Ozaki scheme to accelerate the 'SO(2)-equivariant' processing layers of GNNs, which dominate the runtime of (1) many state-of-the-art ML interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and (2) most universal ML Hamiltonian (MLH) models. translated_title: 通过低精度仿真加速SO(2)等变材料模型
translated_abstract: 旋转等变架构提升了基于图神经网络（GNN）的机器学习通用材料模型的物理保真度。然而，其在训练和推理过程中使用的复杂高精度张量运算限制了可扩展性。采用矩阵乘法单元（MMU）的降精度格式（例如用FP8代替FP32）可大幅提升吞吐量，在NVIDIA Hopper（Blackwell）GPU上最高可达30倍（60倍），但可能导致精度急剧下降。本文提出在整数Ozaki方案下定制的“仿真式”低精度运算，用于加速GNN中的SO(2)等变处理层——这些层主导了以下两类模型的运行时间：(1)许多最先进的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）模型；(2)大多数通用机器学习哈密顿量（MLH）模型。该框架FlashSO(2)在吞吐量和精度上均超越了TF32（最精确的原生低精度MMU格式）。
tldr: 提出FlashSO(2)框架，利用整数Ozaki方案下的仿真式低精度运算加速GNN中的SO(2)等变层，在吞吐量上超越TF32的同时保持精度，可加速机器学习原子间势和通用哈密顿量模型。
